description: Keyword dictionary for multi-label classification of the LLM's free-text reasoning comment (the text after '#' in the action line). Seeded from the June 2026 script agent/analysis/reasoning_quality.py (CATEGORIES); 'threat' is new; 'capacity' kept from the legacy set. A decision receives every category whose keyword list matches (multi-label). 'legacy' keywords reproduce the June classifier exactly; 'added' keywords are revision additions that the author must confirm. Matching mode 'substring' is the legacy behaviour (case-insensitive substring; note that 'day' also matches 'today', 'load' matches 'download'); 'word' matches whole words / word prefixes and is the recommended mode for the paper if the author accepts the deviation from the June classifier.

spatial.description: Position-aware reasoning: where to place, relative to existing BS, frontier, direction, gaps.

reactive.description: Coverage/violation-triggered reasoning: reacting to the current KPI state.

temporal.description: Anticipation of the day/night cycle or future demand; proactive planning.

resource.description: Budget / economy considerations (metal, income, cost, waiting for resources).

noop_justified.description: Explicit justification for not acting (state deemed sufficient/stable).

threat.description: Enemy / threat-zone awareness (S4 adversarial; safety of the network engineer).

valid_reasoning_definition: A decision has 'valid reasoning' iff its reasoning text is non-empty after stripping, does not start with an error prefix (orchestrator API/HTTP error placeholder), and matches at least one taxonomy category.
